title: if_capabilities: Use a structured error msg from dumpcap
description:
Providing the long tutorial on permissions and Linux distros to the
log with MESSAGE priority floods the console and makes it very
inconvenient to use for diagnostics. With Wireshark this is repeated
at startup for every single interface in the system (if it has
insufficient permissions, which is normal during development), and
there are usually many interfaces, compounding the issue.

Use a structured error message from dumpcap and ignore the hints secondary part
of the message when writing to the logs.

commits_data.message:
if_capabilities: Use a structured error msg from dumpcap

Have dumpcap in child mode return an error message with a primary and
secondary string, instead of using stderr. When writing to the console
log we ignore the second message to prevent flooding the log with
tutorial-like info on permissions.
